Buyavsdeals (“we,” “our,” or “us”) operates the website buyavsdeals.online (the “Website”). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your information when you visit our Website or purchase antivirus software, computer accessories, and related gadgets from us. We are committed to protecting your privacy and complying with applicable United States data protection laws.

Buyavsdeals is owned and operated by AllRoundFix LLC, a company committed to delivering reliable products, transparent pricing, and a secure online shopping experience.

1. Information We Collect

a. Personal Information

We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us, including:

  • Full name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Billing and shipping address
  • Order details and purchase history
  • Payment-related information (processed securely by third-party providers)

b. Automatically Collected Information

When you access our Website, we may automatically collect:

  • IP address
  • Browser type and device information
  • Operating system
  • Pages viewed and time spent on the Website
  • Referring and exit pages

2. How We Use Your Information

Buyavsdeals uses collected information to:

  • Process orders and deliver antivirus licenses, accessories, and gadgets
  • Communicate order confirmations, updates, and support responses
  • Improve Website performance and customer experience
  • Detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized activity
  • Comply with legal and regulatory requirements

3. Payment Information

We do not store or directly process your credit or debit card information. All transactions are handled through secure, PCI-DSS compliant third-party payment gateways.

4. Information Sharing and Disclosure

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share information only with:

  • Payment processing partners
  • Shipping and logistics providers
  • Software license distributors (for antivirus activation and delivery)
  • Legal authorities when required by law

All third parties are contractually required to protect your information.

5. Independent Reseller Disclaimer

Buyavsdeals is an independent reseller of antivirus software, computer accessories, and gadgets. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to any third-party brands unless clearly stated.
Use of third-party software is subject to the respective brand’s license agreement and privacy policy.

6. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies to:

  • Enhance user experience
  • Analyze Website traffic and usage trends
  • Remember user preferences

You may manage or disable cookies through your browser settings; however, certain Website features may be limited.

7. Data Security

We implement reasonable technical, administrative, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect data, no online transmission is entirely secure.

8. Your Privacy Rights (U.S. Residents)

Depending on your state of residence, including California, you may have rights to:

  • Access personal information we hold about you
  • Request correction or deletion of your data
  • Opt out of promotional communications

To exercise these rights, contact us using the information below.

9. Children’s Privacy

Our Website is not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

10. Third-Party Links

Our Website may contain links to third-party websites. Buyavsdeals is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those websites.

11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with a revised “Last Updated” date.

12. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
